questions.q: Under complete spatial randomness, events will be…
options: evenly spaced across the study region
equally likely anywhere, so chance clusters and gaps can still appear
questions.why: Random does not mean evenly spaced. Apparent clusters or gaps can arise by chance alone.

questions.q: Crime incidents cluster near bars because bars draw people in. What kind of structure is this?
questions.why: The bars are an external factor that raises the intensity of the process in part of the region. Second-order structure comes from events interacting with each other.

questions.q: A point pattern has an average nearest neighbor ratio of R = 0.6. What does that suggest?
questions.why: R below 1 means points are closer to their nearest neighbors than expected under CSR.
